model_annotation: Figure 5 illustrates the training dynamics of LUFFY compared with on-policy RL, showing three key metrics over the course of training. The left panel plots the outcome training rewards, with the x-axis representing steps on a linear scale from 0 to 1000, and the y-axis showing the training rewards on a linear scale from -2.0 to 0.0. The on-policy RL (blue line) starts at a reward of approximately -1.8 and steadily increases to about -0.2, while LUFFY (orange line) begins at a reward of approximately -1.5 and rises to about -0.3. The middle panel shows the generation length, with the x-axis also representing steps from 0 to 1000, and the y-axis showing length on a linear scale from 0 to 200. The on-policy RL (blue line) starts at a length of 100 and increases to about 120, while LUFFY (orange line) starts at a length of 120 and increases to about 140. The right panel plots the entropy, with the x-axis representing steps from 0 to 1000, and the y-axis showing entropy on a linear scale from 0 to 6. The on-policy RL (blue line) starts at an entropy of 0.5 and increases to about 1.0, while LUFFY (orange line) starts at an entropy of 0.5 and increases to about 1.5.
